headline.title: First flakes for White Mountains.
headline.text: Up to {{s:1.1}} on the summit of Cannon this week. 18 of the 19 resorts close to opening get nights cold enough to make snow, mostly in White Mountains and Northern Vermont. Killington typically opens first, around Nov 8.

snowshoe.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 17 at 12:35AM EDT until October 18 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
snowshoe.text: * WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 29 expected. * WHERE...Portions of northeast Kentucky, southeast Ohio, southwest Virginia, and central, northeast, northern, southeast, southern, and western West Virginia. * WHEN...From 1 AM to 9 AM EDT Sunday. * IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor plumbing.

sevensprings.headline: Freeze Watch issued October 16 at 9:09PM EDT until October 18 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS State College PA
sevensprings.text: * WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 26 possible. * WHERE...A portion of central Pennsylvania. * WHEN...From late Saturday night through Sunday morning. * IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor plumbing. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The coldest areas will be the northern mountains and Laurel Highlands.

camelback.headline: Freeze Watch issued October 16 at 1:14PM EDT until October 18 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
camelback.text: * WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures in the upper 20s to low 30s possible. * WHERE...In New Jersey, Sussex County. In Pennsylvania, Carbon and Monroe Counties. * WHEN...From late Saturday night through Sunday morning. * IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor plumbing.

BTV.excerpt:
Gusty winds to continue through Saturday with much cooler temperatures on the way. First round of snowfall expected for the high peaks tonight.
Next week continues to trend very quiet as high pressure builds in across the area with temperatures near normal and high confidence in an extended dry period of weather.

ALY.excerpt:
) Continued gusty winds and unseasonably chilly conditions are expected tonight through Saturday. A coating to a few tenths of an inch of snow are possible in the higher terrain late tonight into Saturday morning.
) Dry weather with temperatures moderating to near seasonable levels late Sunday into early next week.

GYX.excerpt:
An approaching cold front continues rain chances into this evening with a couple of gusty thunderstorms possible in southern NH.
A seasonably cold airmass and gusty winds arrive behind the cold front to start the weekend, with wintry conditions across the higher terrain.
Mild and dry conditions look to persist from Sunday through much of next week as high pressure dominates over the Northeast.

PHI.excerpt:
A front will continue to slowly move southeast of the area overnight. Showers will taper across Delmarva and New Jersey late tonight.
Frost and freeze conditions are expected for Saturday night into Sunday morning with another round of frost possible for Sunday night into Monday morning.
Uncertainty persists regarding a nor'easter developing off the coast of the southern Mid-Atlantic that may cause unsettled conditions and hazardous marine impacts early next week.

CTP.excerpt:
) Blustery and much turning much colder tonight and Saturday
) Frost and freeze conditions Saturday night into early Sunday

writeups.title: Dry, with cold nights.
paras: Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:20}} to {{t:46}}, with up to {{s:0.7}} of snow.

writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans warmer than normal and slightly drier than normal.
